decision_rule: Pass only when the image is recognizable at browse-card scale, materially matches the documented recognition structure, distinguishes common confusions, and does not overclaim a unique canonical motif for broad terms.
verification_boundary: A structural-review pass advances an image to reviewed, not verified. Source/content verification and final browser QA remain separate gates.

wave2_review_history: The first generated contact sheet was not accepted wholesale. Buffalo Check, Shepherd's Check, Gun Club Check, and Diamond Pattern were regenerated after visual review found insufficient differentiation or edge/tessellation problems. The refined 20-image set was then reviewed again.

notes: Honeycomb read too much like a triangular lattice at thumbnail scale.
Fleur-de-lis, Chintz, Botanical Print, Acanthus, and Ivy needed stronger recognition cues at reduced size.
Honeycomb rebuilt as a true shared-edge hexagonal cell network.
Fleur-de-lis silhouette enlarged and separated into central/side lobes.
Chintz branching and blossoms diversified to reduce garland reading.
Botanical leaves enlarged and given visible midribs.
Acanthus and Ivy leaves enlarged for thumbnail recognition.
All 20 files validated as 1536x1536 RGB PNG and reviewed together as a contact sheet.

Flame Stitch read too much like ordinary chevrons; Tree of Life read as a small sprig; Moire was too faint; Yagasuri read as X/braid columns; Uroko read as diamonds; Kagome lacked recognizable basket-eye structure; Tomoe units were too small.
Chinoiserie and Kalamkari were too icon-like and needed stronger pictorial/style cues.
Flame Stitch, Tree of Life, Moire, Yagasuri, Uroko, Tomoe, Chinoiserie, and Kalamkari improved to acceptable recognition strength.
Kagome still read as isolated six-point stars and Nami Chidori waves read too much like horizontal ornament bands.
Kagome rebuilt as a tighter connected staggered basket-eye network.
Nami Chidori rebuilt with nested semicircle waves and larger plover silhouettes.
All 20 images reviewed together at thumbnail scale and retained as deterministic 1536x1536 RGB recognition references.

wave5_review_history.note: Initial sheet exposed underscaled Suzani/animal/camouflage cues and overly geometric Tie-dye/Marbling.
Scale/fluid refinement accepted broadly; Snake, Giraffe, Sashiko, and Adire required one focused pass.
Focused review confirmed Adire resist geometry, visible Sashiko running-stitch paths, connected Snake scale cells, and Giraffe polygon patches with pale channels.
